{{Quote|It's. Not. Fair. Please. Please steer clear of the shipyard. You lie down with Kuati, you're gonna wake up with Mynocks. Every time.|Corporal Jan Stakross, Maintenance Logs|<ref name="Mynock">{{TFU|game=II|version=[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]]|notes="[[Mynock/Legends|Mynock]]" databank entry}}</ref>}}
A '''joyrider''' secretly [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an old [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] at [[Local day/Legends|nighttimes]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], drawing the ire of [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jan Stakross]]. The joyrider frequented [[Agarrees Shipyard Township]] to "lie down with [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]]"<ref name="Mynock" />&mdash;the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>&mdash;despite Stakross' prior warnings, resulting in the [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhopper's]] power cabling being damaged by the [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]]. The aged Stakross complained that it was simply not fair being forced to clean up after the joyrider's actions in the [[Maintenance Log]]s, pleading to a group of individuals that included one "Antilles" not to visit the mynock-infested shipyard with the T-16 again. The rogue [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] accessed the Maintenance Logs while on the planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]<ref name="Mynock" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' takes place in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to its [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|comic adaptation]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The joyrider was mentioned in the "Mynock" entry in the in-game databank in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[2010]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''. The entry is obtainable on Dagobah.<ref name="Mynock" />
